steps.player: Hey, Soup. Why did you want to follow me?

steps.npc: Sometimes it's nice to stretch the flippers and dry them out.
I wanted to follow someone who looked like they wouldn't let me be turned into Soup soup.

steps.player: Hey, Soup. Where did your name come from?

steps.npc: When you live in salt water, all food is soup.

steps.player: So your favourite food is... food?

using-a-raw-sea-turtle-cooked-sea-turtle.npc: I can't believe you would show me this...

using-a-raw-sea-turtle-cooked-sea-turtle.text: Soup turns away from you and the [raw/cooked/burnt] sea turtle, a single salty tear forming in his eye.

using-non-soup-items-on-soup.npc: No, thank you. I don't want that.

using-a-bowl-of-hot-water-on-soup.npc: That soup doesn't look very tasty.

using-soup-items-on-soup.npc: Can we make this into soup?

using-soup-items-on-soup.text: If the player does not have hot water in their inventory:

steps.player: It isn't soup... I could get you some hot water to make it soup?

using-soup-items-on-soup.text: If the player has hot water in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, I have some hot water here.

steps.text: Soup gobbles up the stew soup.
